changelog:
- Initial release of "Executive Presentation Designer"
- Skill creates or redesigns executive-level presentation decks with premium, modern design
- Defines a workflow for classifying deck type, structuring story arcs, and applying curated visual styles
- Includes clear visual rules, slide patterns, and a step-by-step quality checklist
- Outlines an output standard to ensure consistent, high-quality presentation results
summary: Create or redesign PowerPoint and slide decks into clear, modern presentation materials. Use for PPT layout, visual hierarchy, storytelling, classroom reports, product decks, and presentation design review.
